title: Urban–rural comparison of environmental determinants of foodborne norovirus infections and their relation to paediatric disease burden in South Korea — analysis code
description: Author-authorised R2 analysis-code release for the Scientific Reports norovirus revision. Outcomes remain frozen at 4,801 cases and 220 outbreaks across 1,115 district-years (223 districts, 2020–2024). The revision_R2 directory corrects official facility-level sludge-moisture aggregation, excludes totals/subtotals and inappropriate zero codes, and distinguishes 802 measured from 313 unavailable district-years. It includes principal, paediatric, outbreak-count, spatial-graph, prior, influential-observation, missing-administrative-year and moisture-availability analyses, numerical-repeat and independent maximum-likelihood checks, and validated full-precision results. The earlier positive national moisture association is not reproduced after correction. The archived R1 input object and official annual workbooks are required and are not bundled; precise input requirements and source hashes are documented. Root-level R1 scripts are retained for provenance. No individual patient information is included.
